capabilities: Generate LLM summary cards for note sections with adaptive segmentation
Sync editor scrolling with highlighted cards on the right
Navigate between cards and source lines by click or keyboard
Edit, copy, delete, or export cards as a Markdown note
Configure 20+ AI providers including local backends and CLI backends
disambiguation: Not a side-by-side document comparison tool; it pairs one note with AI summary cards rather than showing two notes.
extras: Cached summaries are keyed by content SHA-1 plus settings fingerprint; edits or config changes show a stale banner. Local model providers (Ollama, LM Studio) need no API key.
intentEvidence: Inspired by this reading workflow demo.
motivation: The author wanted both overview and scannable detail: "pure prose felt like a wall of text, pure bullets felt fragmented."
problem: Long notes are hard to navigate; Obsidian has no built-in way to read a note alongside automatically generated, section-linked summaries.

relations.evidence: If you have Claude Code or Codex installed locally, you can use them as backends
Ollama / LM Studio | Local models, no API key needed

requires.name: Claude Code or Codex CLI (optional backends)

summary: AI split-view reader that shows LLM-generated summary cards beside the source note with scroll-sync highlighting.
